editorial:
Imagine two retired ladies who have completely given up on following the rules. You get to meet Doris and Bettan, a pair of best friends who just want to relax on a sunny Spanish beach with their cocktails and cigarettes. They are living their best lives, topless and carefree, until a grumpy hotel manager decides they are too much for the other guests to handle. The vibe is totally wild and rebellious, turning a simple vacation into a full-blown battle of wills. It is basically a love letter to aging loudly and refusing to be invisible just because you are older.

The animation style is bright and poppy, which makes the action scenes feel like a colorful comic book. You will love how the pacing stays quick, never letting the jokes drag on too long. While some of the humor is a bit crude, it fits the characters perfectly. It is the perfect pick for anyone who needs a break from serious dramas.
endingExplained: After all the chaos at the resort, Doris and Bettan manage to outsmart the manager and the people trying to kick them out. They use their underestimated status as elderly women to pull off a hilarious prank that leaves the hotel in shambles. In the end, they don't change their ways or apologize. They walk away victorious, proving that life is too short to be boring, and they head off to find their next adventure together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves rebellious characters and adult comedies.
